notes: Both pages returned HTTP 200 with server-rendered semantic markup - one <main>, plus <header>, <nav>, <footer>, and <article> on the introduction page. No bot challenge, no JS-only shell, no retries needed. Nothing was rendered or executed: no computed styles, no layout measurements, no screenshots.

/method has a low text-to-HTML ratio (1045 visible characters over 382 KB) because it is a short index page whose weight is the RSC payload inlined across 131 <script> tags; /method/introduction carries 5961 visible characters across 163 script tags. Both ratios are depressed by that inlined payload and should not be read as thin content.

48 external stylesheets (47 fetched on the first pass, 1 on a second single request; all HTTP 200, 215653 bytes / 211 KB of CSS) plus 2 inline <style> blocks, one per page, holding styled-components runtime output (7126 bytes). No @import anywhere. Raw HTML and CSS live under data/design-study/raw/linear_app_method/ and are gitignored.

Token resolution: values shown as resolvedTo were expanded by substituting the first definition of each custom property found in file order. That is reliable for the type and colour scales, which are defined once on :root, but it picks the wrong branch for properties redefined per component or per breakpoint. --p-size and --h3-size are the two cases that matter; both were resolved by hand against the classes actually present in the served markup and are reported correctly in headingScale and bodyCandidates. The raw resolvedTo values in fontSizes/lineHeights should not be trusted for those two.

The reading colour is not the body colour. html,body carries --color-text-primary (#f7f8f8, 18.73:1) but running prose is set to --color-text-secondary (#d0d6e0, 13.64:1) and captions to --color-text-tertiary (#8a8f98, 6.13:1). On a #08090a ground the hierarchy is built from four text greys at 18.7 / 13.6 / 6.1 / 3.5:1 as much as from size or weight. --color-text-quaternary at 3.45:1 fails WCAG AA for normal text and is used for underline colour and the most recessive metadata.

contrastRatioCandidate is computed from plain hex pairs under [data-theme=dark], the theme the pages ship with. Tokens using color-mix() or 8-digit alpha hex (for example --header-bg #0b0b0bcc, --color-bg-translucent #ffffff0d) were not composited and carry no ratio.
headingScale.ratio is null because no single modular ratio fits: the nine-step title scale is hand-tuned and tightens as sizes grow. See ratioNote.
Everything responsive here is read from @media rules, not observed: both pages were fetched once, at no particular viewport, with no device emulation.
